read_candidate_stages.compressed: reads1 + compressed collision fast path and request scratch

source: vendor-source Go overlay points to actual upstream checkout; frozen published baseline binary retained
timing: Non-race Linux binaries. Later runs shared the host with separate macOS correctness tests; stable allocation deltas and balanced repetitions are primary evidence, not production CPU claims.
scale: One candidate-only run per engine; 100000 metrics, 32 workers, three archives, ordered batches of 8, 2400000 points and 30000 reads; not an A/B speedup measurement.
